name: web-four-pastel-role-cards-with-status-pills-and-3d-icons
title: Pastel role cards (Companies, Builders, Scouts, Partners) with status pills, short copy, action links and 3D objects
whatItIs: A 2x2 grid of rounded cards in peach, pale blue, lilac and mint, each with a small pill with a coloured dot (Open / Invite-priority, Open for applications, Invite only), a bold role title, a short paragraph, a bold action link with an arrow (Start hiring, Apply now, Request invite, Get in touch) and a 3D object at the right edge (a guitar-pick shape, a blue shield with a tick, purple cubes, a globe with a sprout).
whatItMeans: Friendly and clear; soft colour and 3D icons sort audiences without heaviness.
techniques: Give each audience a pastel colour.
Use status pills with coloured dots.
Place a 3D icon at the right edge.
Keep one bold action link per card.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule with a dot and a state label.
A card describing a type of participant.
A rendered object bleeding off the card edge.
A bold link with an arrow.
